# metabase_user (Data Source)

A Metabase user.

This data source can be useful to find the Metabase ID of a user based on its email address, for example to reference a
user that was created by SSO rather than by Terraform.

Deactivated users are returned as well, with `is_active` set to `false`. Reading a user never changes it: this
data source never reactivates a deactivated account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Looking up a user that was created by SSO rather than by Terraform.
data "metabase_user" "jane" {
  email = "jane.doe@example.com"
}

# Users can also be looked up using their Metabase ID.
data "metabase_user" "by_id" {
  id = 3
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) The email address of the user. If specified, the `id` should not be specified.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the user. If specified, the `email` should not be specified.

### Read-Only

- `common_name` (String) The display name for the user, computed by Metabase from the first and last names.
- `date_joined` (String) The date at which the user was created.
- `first_name` (String) The first name of the user.
- `group_ids` (Set of Number) The IDs of the permissions groups the user belongs to. The `All Users` group (ID `1`) and the `Administrators` group (ID `2`) are managed by Metabase itself and are not reported here, see `is_superuser` for the latter.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the user is active. Deactivated users cannot log in.
- `is_superuser` (Boolean) Whether the user is an administrator of the Metabase instance.
- `last_login` (String) The date at which the user last logged in, or null if it never did.
- `last_name` (String) The last name of the user.
- `locale` (String) The locale used by Metabase when displaying the interface to the user.
- `sso_source` (String) The SSO provider the user authenticates with (e.g. `google`), or null for a password-based account.
